title: Xteink X4 Pro Pocket eReader $135.00 Delivered @ Xteink
body:
Deal: Xteink X4 Pro Pocket eReader $135.00 Delivered @ Xteink

[3dprintdeals] Cheaper from Aliexpress when stacking codes & cashbacks.
Example for X3 , but listing also has X4 Classic & X4 Pro
[Vavoom] Agreed. With stacking and cashback, got it for around $80-90.
[habib23q] Yep same here. Gotta love them sales and cashback deals.
[Mokr] But then you get the china version, which still has mandarin after you change langauge to eng.
Also can't use a usb interface.
[ozbagends] Nah it's all english now, after you apply the OTA update. USB works, just connect the pogo adaptor that's included
[habib23q] Yes there's an english os flash option now that can be flashed to unlock the chinese version's.
[ozbagends] Got it for $90 aud delivered from aliexpress
[Vavoom] Apparently the default firmware is now up to scratch so Crosspoint/ink isn't so necessary. Mine hasn't arrived to try yet so I'll report back.
[Boom87] I couldn’t use the app with mine as it needed Chinese number to register so had no choice but to flash it. Which is a shame as the native firmware is nice
[Mokr] @Boom87: You can use an email to access, the default china firmware.
[Boom87] @Mokr: Weird, it’s the first field it asks for is a phone number to bind the account. Couldn’t see anyway around it. I’ll look on YouTube if there’s something I’m missing!
[SKS01] @Boom87: You need to select HK, it will allow you to use a normal phone number and an email.
[eshaylad123] i got one recently and flashed successfully
[ozbagends] Nah I didn't firmware shipped with it is great
[oooooooo ahhhhhhh] I have one, really enjoy it. Small enough to slip in my pocket with my phone.
[habib23q] I got the og Xteink x4 at the start of the year and both the Pro and x3 all from Aliexpress sales and cashback so this is overpriced. But ymmv and there's a few dodgy sellers on Aliexpress that do waste time and eventually cancelled my orders throughout the year for the X4.
It's an amazing device, ive used the Stock os and Crossink and Crosspoint on both the x4s and the x3 is using the stock os. I have read 4 books on mine and am rotating using it with a 6inch kobo and syncing them together to swap them out.
[habib23q] Yes. Check out the Stefan Svartling youtube channel for all your ereaders tutorials and stuff. I've been watching his channel for years and he does all sorts of tutorials besides the usual reviews on all sorts of devices incluidng the usual Kindles and Kobos too.
[habib23q] @3dprintdeals: Yeah i just got mine about 2 weeks ago and my daughter loves it. She was using a kindle basic 2019 before but hasn't touched it since.
[3dprintdeals] @habib23q: it's also for my kid, always glued to kindle 7"
[habib23q] @3dprintdeals: I'm moving away from all my Kindles personally onto Kobos. Even tho i had jb Kindles lol
[Whodis] Just beware these are really fragile. Mine lasted less than 2 weeks before the screen broke. Went and got a boox picco instead. I think that’s less flimsy because it’s a bit thicker, and the USB-c is less fiddly than the pogo.
[habib23q] Yeah thats true. I use mine with not only the magnetic hard cover but also have a small hard case that i bought cheap off Aliexpress which was i think a earphones case but is exactly the size of the reader with the cover on. I also have both the x4s in it along with the pogo adapter and a flexible ulanzi booklight for my og X4 in it as well.
[ts13] I have an original X4 and had it about 6 months. I wouldn't say I daily drive it (trying to get back into reading…) but I have read 2-3 fat books partially on it and it has survived really well. I initially used without a case, then put a case on it after reading others' comments. Then hated the added bulk and removed again. Largely, ymmv I guess.
[habib23q] Yes thats true but tbh the case for these devices hardly add any bulk. I think in this case especially it's worth it if it avoids it being broken easily.
[simulacrum] How are you finding the picco? I've been considering one for a while? Were you able to get a good deal on it somewhere?
[Whodis] It’s smaller in hand, but thicker. For my maybe a tad more uncomfortable to hold than the x4 pro (medium sized disposable gloves hand size if that helps), but that’s really just nitpicking. Software wise not really an issue either way because I put crosspoint/crossink on both so it’s basically the same.
I got it directly off boox. Was 105usd.
[Whodis] https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1131221121…
Supposedly this is 30 off with coupon, so 129aud? So far the boox has outlasted the x4pro, so I’d say worth the extra money? 🤣
[3dprintdeals] looks good, have you also looked at EEGO A4?
[RolandWaites] Don't see the appeal of a tiny e-reader. Either you're looking at a font so small that it'll invariably strain your eyes, or you're changing page every 20 seconds. Paperback size is the most logical and aesthetically pleasing format.
[Whodis] Because it’s small and you can read it anywhere and keep it in your pocket instead of having to think about how you’re going to stow it. I have 2 kindles I stopped using because it was annoying to carry, and started reading on iOS Books instead. But the blue light tendency makes it hard to read at bed time.
[3dprintdeals] it's about the same as reading ozbargain on your phone.
[eshaylad123] i was worried this would be the case but it's actually fine for me, i wouldn't get an x3 though
[pcwa218] So the cheaper aliexpress one for $90 is the china version and need to flash the firmware later?
[3dprintdeals] it's not essential to flash the firmware, it's just an option.
Stock OS has improved a lot since first release
[pcwa218] But the people comment before mention you need to have a china mobile number to bind account? If not flash?
[habib23q] No theres a workaround. You switch the region to hk and can use a email to register and sync it. But theres a step or two more that you have to do as well.
[Whodis] I think you can flash it before you need to register anyway, bit of a non issue really.
[drillvoice] I recently got the X3 from aliexpress via another OzBargain deal. When it arrived it was Chinese rom and I couldn't sign up (needed a Chinese number) and I was like WTF but then I flashed crosspoint reader which was quite easy to do, and since then I've been quite happy with it. I am reading more and reading when I wouldn't have otherwise, which was the whole idea. Definitely handy being able to slip it in a pocket and have it with me wherever I go - would not do this with a kindle. Also easier to get content on to it, I'd say.
[nuts] Got one off AE last week. Screen already cooked. Back it goes for a full refund.
